sections.value:
Only reviewer/330 remains held; 328, 329 and 331 are answered and released. As checked November 22, 2026 at 06:53 +10:00, #330 is still OPEN at 6d855e8. Its final-round BLOCK is 1039136, unresolved B330-R2-01; blocked report is spine 4713352. Await coder fix or PM disposition from pij-steady-otter. An idle nudge does not override hold-until-merge, and C34 permits no new broad third round.

Do not repeat the technical lesson: open 2026-11-22-stop-inference-cannot-equate-attachment. Session ae639be0-bf8b-4dcf-b1a3-21645f441861 retains pr330-r2-stop-regression.rs, pr330-r2-stop-inference.log and pr330-r2-causal-control.log as proof artifacts. Temporary source archives and test binaries were cleaned; all original checkouts remained untouched. Recreate an exact-head archive if proof must run again. The regression is a child of control_mode.rs, not a standalone Cargo test target: place it in a nested test directory and declare its module there. No unfinished tests or unsent verdicts remain.
